name: @hivemagnus/magnus
description: Install, upgrade and roll back a Magnus server and console with one command: `npx @hivemagnus/magnus init`, then `magnus upgrade`. Pins exact, tested component versions, backs up PostgreSQL before every migration and reverts automatically when the new version fails its health check.
author: ChefTaco

migrations.name: 20261127120000_ardent_agent_operation_model_credential_kind
migrations.note: Widen the Ardent operation kind check to the model-credential operations that set an existing agent's Emberpath client key; existing rows already satisfy it and are unchanged.

magnusRelease.summary: New Agent and agent definition installs deliver the Emberpath client key an Emberpath alias model needs (emberpath_client_key, checked against Emberpath's model list, sent only to an explicit MAGNUS_ARDENT_EMBERPATH_URL, never stored), and POST /ardent/installations/:nodeId/profiles/:name/model-credential sets or rotates it on an existing agent. Both need node agents at studio level 6 (upgrade agents first) and a HiveXUI release after 0.14.0 for the key field. Wazuh 5 manager endpoint reporting. Ardent stays 3.5.1. One fast migration widens the Ardent operation kind check to model-credential.
